# Association for Crime Scene Reconstruction (ACSR)

> International professional association providing crime scene reconstruction training, certification, research grants, and peer-reviewed publications for forensic science professionals.

ACSR is a leading organization for forensic professionals specializing in crime scene reconstruction and documentation. The association hosts major conferences, offers specialized certifications like laser scanning, maintains rigorous ethical standards, and publishes open-access research in forensic science.

## Key Topics

- Crime Scene Reconstruction
- Forensic Science
- Laser Scanning Technology

## Organization & Leadership

- [HOME | Association for Crime Scene Reconstruction](https://www.acsr.org): ACSR homepage: international forensic professionals association for crime scene reconstruction training and education.
- [Board of Directors | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/board-of-directors): ACSR board members and organizational leadership structure for 2025-2026.
- [Code of Ethics | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/code-of-ethics): ACSR professional conduct standards and ethics complaint procedures for members.

## Membership & Professional Development

- [Membership Info | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/membership-info): ACSR membership types, requirements, fees, and application process for forensic professionals.
- [Research Grants | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/grants): ACSR research grant funding opportunities for forensic science and crime scene reconstruction.
- [Basic Laser Scanning Certification | IAFSM](https://www.acsr.org/blsc): IAFSM-accredited Basic Laser Scanning Certification course for crime scene documentation.

## Publications & Research

- [JOURNAL | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/journal): ACSR open-access academic journal for crime scene reconstruction and forensic science.

## Conference 2026

- [Crime Scene Reconstruction Joint Conference Hosted by ACSR & IAFSM | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/event-details/crime-scene-reconstruction-joint-conference-hosted-by-acsr-iafsm): 2026 ACSR-IAFSM joint conference in Boulder featuring 3D technology and laser scanning.
- [Speakers (List) | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/speakers): List of forensics experts and speakers for ACSR conference presentations.
- [Presentation & Workshop Abstr... (List) | ACSR](https://www.acsr.org/presentation-workshop-abstracts): Conference presentation abstracts covering firearms analysis, AI, and 3D imaging.
- [Hotel Booking | ACSR & IAFSM Joint Conference](https://www.acsr.org/hotel-booking): Hotel booking and group rates for 2026 ACSR-IAFSM conference in Boulder.
- [Vendor Information | ACSR & IAFSM Joint Conference](https://www.acsr.org/vendor-information): Vendor registration and sponsorship information for 2026 ACSR-IAFSM joint conference.
